Legal employer inside a tenant (ORG-01). Statutory registrations (ORG-02) are later work.

| Kind | aggregate-root |

## Constraints

- PK (tenant_id, id)
- FK tenant_id -> tenant
- legal_name_en 1-300 chars
- production_payroll_enabled must be false (ORG-08)
- optimistic version
- audit required
